senses.gloss: f. (אגר I, Pi; cmp. אֵגוֹרִי) (grain) fit for storage, of superior quality. Y. Maas. Sh. IV, beg. 54ᵈ מן הא׳ על השמתית וכ׳ T’rumah may be taken from the stored-up wheat for the wheat which has to be quickly disposed of, or vice versa.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 2:4:2">Y. Peah. II, 17ᵃ</cite> <he>חצי איגדו וכ׳</he> (read <cite ref="A00344"><he>איגרו</he></cite>).

Y. Naz. V, 54ᵃ שחתית ונמצאת אגרון (corr. acc.) from dark colored wheat (inferior), and found it was igg’ru (superior). [R. Simson to Peah II, 5 quotes אֵגוֹרִי; El. W. in Sh’noth El. ibid. אֲגוֹרָה.] [B. Bath. V, 6 has לבנה white, pure for our w.]
